title: Abba Chagrat
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Derekh Eretz Rabbah, chapter 1: Abba Chalfi says in the name of his father, Abba Chagrat: “Do not be reckless with vows, lest you violate oaths; do not linger with an ignorant priest; and do not converse excessively with a woman.” (Nedarim presents the saying anonymously as a tannaitic teaching.) Shabbat 105b has Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar speaking in the name of Chilfa bar Agra. It appears that he is Abba Chagrat: aleph interchanges with chet in the Jerusalem Talmud, as in Ilfa–Chilfa.

notes.text: The father-son wording and identification of Abba Chagrat with Chilfa bar Agra are Hyman’s. The warning means not to linger with an ignorant priest.
